items.question: Simran picked 24 red apples and 19 green apples from the orchard. How many apples did she pick in all?
There were 52 birds sitting on a tree. 26 birds flew away. How many birds are left on the tree?
There are 36 boys and 28 girls in the school playground. How many children are in the playground altogether?
Priya had 45 stickers. Her mother gave her 18 more stickers. Then she gave 12 stickers to her brother. How many stickers does Priya have now?
Aryan had 70 marbles. He gave 38 marbles to his friend. How many marbles does Aryan have now?
A baker made 45 muffins in the morning and 27 more muffins in the afternoon. How many muffins did the baker make in all?
